newsitem.title: USA: Regency seen as buyout target-Business Week.
newsitem.headline: Regency seen as buyout target-Business Week.

text.p: Regency Health Services Inc is a possible takeover target, Business Week reported, citing an unnamed New York investment manager.
The healthcare company is worth between $22 and $25 a share in a buyout, the manager said, adding that recently there has been heavy big-block buying of the company's stock.
Richard Matros, chief executive of the company, denied that regency was a takeover target, Business Week said.
The company's shares closed Thursday at 14-9/16, down 1/16.
